subject: Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor trigger 806592752 / 260724564 is not a GRB
submitter: Peter Veres at University of Alabama in Huntsville <veresp@gmail.com>
body:
Peter Veres (UAH) reports on behalf of the Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor Team:

"The Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor (GBM) trigger 806592752 / 260724564 at 13:32:27.79 UT
on 24 July 2026, tentatively classified as a GRB, is in fact not due
to a GRB. This trigger is likely due to particle activity."
